content: CONFLICTING SIGNAL: general web sources describe Bithumb private WS path as wss://ws-api.bithumb.com/websocket/v1/private (JWT bearer auth via Authorization header built from access key + nonce + timestamp), while project RESEARCH.md states v2 (.../websocket/v2/private). Both cannot be simultaneously current; low-confidence secondary sources disagree with the authoritative doc. Must be resolved against apidocs.bithumb.com directly before M1/M6A.
